description: Header file defining the PacFileFetcherImpl class, which implements a proxy auto-config (PAC) file fetcher using network requests within the Chromium project. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and member variables related to fetching and handling PAC files over network protocols.

classes.name: PacFileFetcherImpl
classes.description: Implements a network-based PAC file fetcher supporting HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, and data schemes, managing network requests, timeouts, and response handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a PacFileFetcherImpl instance with a given URLRequestContext.

methods.name: SetTimeoutConstraint
methods.description: Sets the maximum duration for the fetch operation.

methods.name: SetSizeConstraint
methods.description: Sets the maximum response size in bytes.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Initiates fetching of a PAC file from a specified URL.
